svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 77
svg.desc: Heat-driven liquid-desiccant dehumidification and heat-pump air conditioning. Geothermal heat is proposed for regeneration; pumps, fans and compressors retain their required electrical inputs. Key: 溶液除湿 = liquid-desiccant dehumidification; 再生 = regeneration; 新风 = fresh air; 回风 = return air; 送风 = supply air; 排风 = exhaust; 热泵 = heat pump; 换热器 = heat exchanger.
